title: How Corruption Destroys Armies - Theft, Graft, and Russian failure in Ukraine
summary: Perun analyzes how corruption and theft in defence procurement hollowed out the Russian military before its invasion of Ukraine. It explains the mechanics of graft and how it degrades capability.
why: Recommended as a long but insightful explanation of how corruption works inside institutions.

quote.text: Both these videos are long, but they had a lot of interesting ideas and insight on this topic
